title: Cam Orchestrator Self-Handoff
description: Machine-readable state the long-lived orchestrator session writes when it approaches its token budget (CAM-23), so a fresh orchestrator can rehydrate instead of cold-starting after a silent auto-compaction. Written by the orchestrator agent, read by buildOrchestratorBootPrompt on respawn. Hard rule: no handoff field enumerates the backlog; the backlog is always derived live via `cam issue list` (or the stage-filtered fallback over scripts/cam/issues/*.json) in the fresh session, never carried forward as a snapshot in this file.

schemaVersion.description: Handoff schema version. The reader rejects unknown versions so a forward-incompatible file is never silently mis-read.

writtenAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the handoff was written.

reason.description: Why the handoff was triggered, e.g. 'token-budget-exceeded'.

projectContext.description: What the project is and where it stands: the durable context a fresh session needs.

currentCycle.description: The issue or cycle currently in flight (id, branch, state).

keyDecisions.description: Decisions made this session worth carrying forward.

openState.description: Open working state: what is in progress, what is staged or pushed, what is pending.

openQuestions.description: Unresolved questions the fresh session should resolve.

nextActions.description: Ephemeral, cycle-specific continuation steps the fresh orchestrator should take next (e.g. 'resume PR review for CAM-190'). Never a backlog snapshot: do not enumerate individual backlog issues here. No handoff field enumerates the backlog; it is always derived live via `cam issue list` in the fresh session.
